name: Supabase Storage
summary: Supabase Storage is a file storage system built into Supabase for storing and serving images, videos, and other files, with an S3-compatible API.

free_plan_covers.note: Free plan includes 1 GB storage and 5 GB cached egress a month, with a 50 MB max file size per upload.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Pro plan is $25/month and raises limits to 100 GB storage and 250 GB cached egress before overage charges.

portability.note: Storage exposes an S3-compatible API alongside Supabase's own SDK, so buckets work with standard S3 tools.

direct_uploads.note: Browsers can upload directly using signed upload URLs or the Supabase client SDK, without routing files through your server.

egress_fees.note: Cached egress beyond the free 5 GB/month costs $0.03 per GB; the Pro plan includes 250 GB before overage.

setup.step: Create a free Supabase account and a new project at supabase.com.
Install the Supabase client with npm install @supabase/supabase-js (add @supabase/ssr if your framework renders pages on the server).
Copy the Project URL and publishable key from the project's Connect panel and add them to your environment file.
Create a storage bucket from the dashboard or the client library, and set access policies for it.
Use signed upload URLs to let users upload files directly from the browser to the bucket.

builder_notes: Set row level security policies on storage buckets; do not assume a bucket is private by default.
Use signed upload URLs for browser uploads instead of proxying file bytes through your own server.
Keep the service role key on the server only; never expose it to client code.
